$Comment: The second rung of Marn's Edge: the metal for the head. Cobalt bars come from a smelter, not
the mill, so for once the woodcutter is sent to the furnace, and the mill keeps running in the
bring_bars is an exact-id hand-in of cobalt bars to Marn only (TurnInNpcId 'giver'); run_cycles
is WORK_STATION on the station id and counts real cycles only. Both sit on Order 1, so the
errand and the shift run side by side and the rung settles once both are in. The seven bars
are the count the vanilla cobalt hatchet's own recipe asks for, so a player who has read that
recipe knows why the number is what it is.
Rewards sit in Claim: Woodcutting XP and a personal Woodcutting boost token (the Mmo_Boost_Token
kind: Skill, Multiplier, DurationMinutes). The Chains entry files it as tier 2 of marns_edge.
Retune the bar count to make the errand longer or shorter, and the cycle count to change how
much milling is expected alongside it.
Name: Cold_Metal
